{{Lunisolar February}}
'''February 11''' is the 11th day of the month {{ill|February (Lunisolar)|cdo|Nùng-lĭk 2 nguŏk|hak|Nùng-la̍k 2-ngie̍t|ja|2月 (旧暦)|ko|음력 2월|simple|Kisaragi|th|เดือนยี่|wuu|农历二月|za|Ndwenngeih|zh|农历二月|zh_min_nan|Kū-le̍k 2 goe̍h|zh_yue|二月|qid=Q838935|lt=February (Kisaragi)}}, the 2nd month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}}. Its {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}} day is {{ill|Shakkō|ja|赤口|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11635368}}.
== Events ==
* {{ill|Nin'an|ja|仁安|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q18925702}} 2nd year ({{ill|Julian calendar|en|Julian calendar|qid=Q11184|lt=Julian calendar}} {{ill|1167|en|1167|qid=Q19678|lt=1167}} {{ill|March 4|en|March 4|qid=Q2396|lt=March 4}}) – {{ill|Taira no Kiyomori|en|Taira no Kiyomori|qid=Q281833|lt=Taira no Kiyomori}} assumed the office of {{ill|Minister (government)|en|Minister (government)|qid=Q83307|lt=Daijō-daijin}} in one fell swoop without going through the positions of Left and Right Minister, thereby establishing the Taira clan regime.
* {{ill|Genroku|en|Genroku|qid=Q1325001|lt=Genroku}} 7th year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1694|en|1694|qid=Q7694|lt=1694}} {{ill|March 6|en|March 6|qid=Q2399|lt=March 6}}) – The event known as the {{ill|Duel at Takadanobaba|ja|高田馬場の決闘|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11672248}} took place.
* {{ill|Culture|en|Culture|qid=Q11042|lt=Bunka}} 1st year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1804|en|1804|qid=Q6894|lt=1804}} {{ill|March 22|en|March 22|qid=Q2435|lt=March 22}}) – For the issuance of the historical edict {{ill|Kōshi Kakurei|ja|鐘匱の制|qid=Q140445965}}, the era name was changed from {{ill|Kyōwa|en|Kyōwa|qid=Q960763|lt=Kyōwa}} to {{ill|Culture|en|Culture|qid=Q11042|lt=Bunka}}.
* {{ill|Bunkyū|en|Bunkyū|qid=Q730266|lt=Bunkyū}} 2nd year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1862|en|1862|qid=Q7698|lt=1862}} {{ill|March 11|en|March 11|qid=Q2398|lt=March 11}}) – The Tokugawa shogunate held a wedding ceremony at Edo Castle for the Shōgun, {{ill|Tokugawa Iemochi|en|Tokugawa Iemochi|qid=Q348466|lt=Tokugawa Iemochi}}, and his imperial consort, {{ill|Chikako, Princess Kazu|en|Chikako, Princess Kazu|qid=Q907048|lt=Waminya Ochi Naishinnō}}.
== Births ==
* {{ill|Genroku|en|Genroku|qid=Q1325001|lt=Genroku}} 7th year ({{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1694|en|1694|qid=Q7694|lt=1694}} {{ill|March 6|en|March 6|qid=Q2399|lt=March 6}}) – {{ill|Arisugawa-no-miya Tadahito-shinnō|ja|有栖川宮正仁親王|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11516504}}, the 4th head of the Arisugawa-no-miya (died {{ill|1716|en|1716|qid=Q6892|lt=1716}}).
